CLI Quickstart

The Nexus CLI is the fastest way to get started. Run one command and your editors are configured automatically.

Install the CLI​

Install globally
npm install -g @nexus/cli

added 42 packages in 3s

nexus --version
@nexus/cli 1.0.0

Run the Setup Wizard​

The nexus init command automatically configures MCP servers in your editors:

nexus init
nexus init

★ Welcome to Nexus!
The AI Documentation & Skills Hub

⚠ Not logged in - run nexus auth login to authenticate

Select your editors:
  ✓ Claude Code   - Anthropic's official CLI for Claude
  ✓ Cursor        - The AI-first code editor
    OpenCode      - Open-source AI code editor
    VS Code       - Visual Studio Code with Copilot
    Zed           - High-performance code editor

Space to toggle, Enter to confirm

After selecting your editors, Nexus configures them:

Configuration Complete
✓ Nexus is ready!

Configured:
  ✓ Claude Code
  ✓ Cursor

Quick commands:
  nexus docs search react hooks
  nexus skills list
  nexus servers list
  nexus stats

✓ Setup complete! Configured 2 editor(s).
Project-specific config

Run nexus init inside a project directory to create a local .nexusrc file with project-specific settings.

Core Commands​

Documentation Search​

Search indexed library documentation:

Search Documentation
nexus docs search react

Found 3 libraries matching "react":

  react            The library for web and native user interfaces
  react-router     Declarative routing for React
  react-query      Powerful data synchronization for React

nexus docs query react "useEffect cleanup"

Found 5 results for "useEffect cleanup" in react:

1. Cleaning up Effects
   Return a cleanup function from useEffect to handle...
   Source: react.dev/reference/react/useEffect

2. Synchronizing with Effects
   Effects let you synchronize with external systems...

Memory Management​

Store and retrieve project context:

Save Project Context
nexus memory save --title "Project Architecture" --type project_context --project myapp --content "Monorepo with Turborepo"

✓ Memory saved: Project Architecture
ID: mem_abc123

nexus memory search "authentication"

Found 2 memories matching "authentication":

1. Auth Pattern Decision (decision)
   Using JWT with httpOnly cookies for authentication...

2. Login Flow Implementation (session_summary)
   Implemented OAuth2 with Google provider...

Server Registry​

Discover and configure MCP servers:

Find MCP Servers
nexus servers search database

Found 5 servers for "database":

  postgres       PostgreSQL database access
  sqlite         SQLite database operations
  mysql          MySQL database connector
  mongodb        MongoDB document database
  redis          Redis key-value store

nexus servers config postgres --format claude-desktop

Add this to your claude_desktop_config.json:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "postgres": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres"],
      "env": {
        "DATABASE_URL": "postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/db"
      }
    }
  }
}

Local MCP Server​

Run Nexus as a local MCP server for offline access:

Start Local Server
nexus serve

Nexus MCP Server
Mode: stdio
Version: 1.0.0

✓ Server ready
Waiting for MCP client connection...

Configure your AI client to use the local server:

claude_desktop_config.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "command": "nexus",
      "args": ["serve"]
    }
  }
}
When to use local mode
  • Offline development — No internet required
  • Custom libraries — Index your own documentation
  • Privacy — Keep memory and queries local
  • Development — Contributing to Nexus itself

Authentication​

Authenticate to enable memory sync and higher rate limits:

Login
nexus auth login

Command Reference​

CommandDescription
nexus initInteractive setup wizard
nexus serveStart local MCP server
nexus docs search <query>Find libraries by name
nexus docs query <lib> <query>Search library documentation
nexus docs listList indexed libraries
nexus memory saveStore a new memory
nexus memory search <query>Semantic search memories
nexus memory listList recent memories
nexus memory contextGet project context
nexus servers search <query>Find MCP servers
nexus servers listList all servers
nexus servers info <id>Server details
nexus servers config <id>Generate install config
nexus auth loginAuthenticate
nexus auth logoutClear credentials
nexus statsView usage statistics
Getting help

Run nexus --help or nexus <command> --help for detailed usage information.
